summary: Local kayaker Chris Goodnough pinned underwater for about 25 minutes at Old Growth Drop, a six-foot drop on Oh Be Joyful Creek; his left foot was caught in the boat and he survived by maintaining an air pocket while companions rigged a V-system rope rescue and freed the boat. Crested Butte SAR arrived within 15-20 minutes of the 7 p.m. call, carried him down the drainage and across the Slate River to a waiting ambulance; treated at Gunnison Valley Hospital and released that night with trauma to his left calf and ankle.
location: Oh Be Joyful Creek, Slate River drainage (Old Growth Drop), ~4 mi from Crested Butte
notes: Boating party of four (Goodnough, Ethan Passant, Chris Menges, Paul Muirhead) running the race-course section; date verified as Monday 2011-07-18.
